hard_constraints: Use Star Wars Legends / Expanded Universe continuity per Canon Contract.
Galactic Alliance Guard (GAG) aligns with canon_preserved: Ben and Desh served under Jacen Solo.
Replace anachronistic terms: 'gun' or 'blaster pistol/rifle'; 'radio' or 'comlink/comm channel'; 'computer' or 'console/terminal'.
Nonlethal takedowns required per scene card to reflect Desh's operational read: 'break equipment, not kill people'.
canon_risks: GAG techniques must feel like Legacy of the Force-era spec ops (silent, efficient), not modern spec ops.

Ash-Tithe Compact opposition should be specific without taking over the climax: hired guards as obstacles, Mira Dann as low Force-sensitive warning/calibration, Pira Kul as technical countermeasure commander; Vess and Serran matter through evidence/ritual context rather than direct Desh combat.
legends_continuity_notes: 47 ABY post-Fate of the Jedi: Galactic Alliance government, Jedi Order under Luke on Coruscant, Empire remnant.
Ben Skywalker: Jedi Knight, former GAG member under Jacen Solo/Darth Caedus, per canon_preserved.
Comms as comlinks; blasters standard; non-Force-sensitive operative competence fits Desh's profile as ex-GAG.
Force wounds (e.g., Malachor V, Nathema) provide precedent for unreliable Force-sense near nodes.
required_context_for_drafter: POV: Ben Skywalker close third; track Desh via node effects, infrastructure pressure, telemetry, and comm bursts, not Desh interiority or direct observation (Ben not physically present).
Desh Rolan: non-Force-sensitive ex-GAG, Ben's friend; sabotage three amplification nodes nonlethally and preserve Pira Kul alive as technical evidence.
Amplification array/nodes: Veraine's repurposing of Ruusan Corridor anchor infrastructure; disabling drops below threshold (needs ~8 nodes).
Crew: Ash-Tithe Compact pressure: hired guards at node one, Mira's low Force-sensitive calibration touch at node two, Pira Kul's reinforced control housing and guard direction at node three.

Beats from Ben POV: first node hard knot goes dark after Desh's comm clicks; first clipped report confirms nonlethal takedowns; second node flares with Mira's warning and dies; third node resists under Pira's countermeasures; comm: 'Array's down. Whatever you're doing — do it now. Everything. Don't hold back.'
Emotional arc: forced trust -> escalating off-site danger -> handoff through competence.

Setting: Veranthos mid-valley resonance position, with nodes rendered through Ben's infrastructure sense, comm, and telemetry; sensory: hard knots in the field, sparking equipment on feed, static, array pressure changing.
allowed_au_divergences: Amplification array/nodes as Veraine's creation from canon_overridden anchor infrastructure.
Desh Rolan as named ex-GAG operative partnering with Ben, per ensemble_cast.
Veranthos as AU vergence/wound site with node installations.
Nonlethal GAG-derived sabotage as Desh's chosen repurposing of skills.
